article.title: FCC router ban docket stays active
article.summary: With the FCC granting more conditional approvals and waivers for broadband routers, CTIA and WNC are now seeking special dispensation.
article.title_zh: FCC 路由器禁令檔案保持活躍
article.summary_zh: 隨著 FCC 批准更多寬頻路由器的有條件批准和豁免，CTIA 和 WNC 現在尋求特殊豁免。

article.title: Lumen Completes Acquisition of Cloud Networking Firm Alkira
article.summary: Chris Stansbury, CFO, of Lumen and Nina Trentmann, Bloomberg News Senior Editor join Bloomberg Businessweek Daily discuss their recent acquisition of Alkira, a cloud-native networking company that helps enterprises manage connectivity across cloud, data center, and edge environments through a single control plane. (Source: Bloomberg)
article.title_zh: Lumen 完成對雲端網路公司 Alkira 的收購
article.summary_zh: Lumen CFO Chris Stansbury 和 Bloomberg News 高級編輯 Nina Trentmann 在 Bloomberg Businessweek Daily 討論其最近對雲端原生網路公司 Alkira 的收購。

article.title: WSJ: Apple avoided semiconductor tariffs last year thanks to Intel chip deal
article.summary: Intel in the U.S. is expected to make at least some upcoming Mac and iPhone chips for Apple. That recent development may have been the key to a major tariff exemption on semiconductors Apple received almost a year ago.
article.title_zh: WSJ：Apple 因 Intel 芯片協議去年成功迴避半導體關稅
article.summary_zh: Intel 預計將為 Apple 生產部分 Mac 和 iPhone 芯片，這項協議可能是 Apple 獲得半導體關稅豁免的關鍵因素。

article.title: Google Photos’ latest UI experiment has one job: getting CapCut on your phone
article.summary: Credit: Shimul Sood / Android Authority TL;DR Google is testing a new set of sharing features in Google Photos. Among these is an option to share and edit media using CapCut. If you don’t have the app installed, it will prompt you to download it from the Play Store. Google appears to be testing a range of minor tweaks in Google Photos. These include a new name for a feature that makes video editing effortless , as well as a way to gamify your Memories . Along with these, we’ve discovered another change that appears to be pushing a popular third-party video editing app. You’re reading an Authority Insights story. Authority Insights brings you all the latest exclusive reports, app teardowns, leaks, and in-depth tech coverage from the Android Authority team that you won’t find anywhere else.
article.title_zh: Google Photos 最新的 UI 實驗有一個工作：將 CapCut 裝到你的手機上
article.summary_zh: Google 正測試 Google Photos 中的新分享功能，包括使用 CapCut 分享和編輯媒體的選項。

article.title: OpenAI launches an AI agent built to automate your entire job
article.summary: Credit: Edgar Cervantes / Android Authority TL;DR OpenAI has launched ChatGPT Work alongside GPT 5.6. The new agent can gather context across apps, files, and workflows to create documents, spreadsheets, and presentations. ChatGPT Work works on mobile, web, and desktop. After a short preview period to give the Trump Administration time to review security concerns, OpenAI is officially debuting GPT 5.6 . With GPT 5.6, the company is releasing three models: Sol, Terra, and Luna. But that’s not the only reveal the company has today, as it also introduced ChatGPT Work. Today, OpenAI announced the launch of ChatGPT Work. This new agent can gather context across apps, files, and workflows to create documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and web apps. article.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 AI 代理，可自動化您的整個工作
article.summary_zh: OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT Work 代理，可跨應用、檔案和工作流收集上下文，創建文件、試算表和簡報。

article.title: Meta debuts Muse Spark 1.1 — its first paid AI model
article.summary: Meta on Thursday rolled out Muse Spark 1.1, a major update to its AI platform, just three months after launching its first model under AI chief Alexandr Wang. The launch appears to be a sign of just how urgently Meta Platforms CEO Mark Zuckerberg wants to close the gap with OpenAI and Anthropic. Wang described Muse Spark 1.1 in a recent CNBC interview as the lab’s “strongest model for agentic and coding work yet.” The first Muse Spark, internally called Avocado, shipped in April under a closed partner program with no public-facing API. This time around, Meta is opening a developer portal with a public waitlist. Don’t expect to find it on OpenRouter or other third-party marketplaces, though — Meta is keeping distribution on its own servers for now. It’s t
article.title_zh: Meta 推出 Muse Spark 1.1 — 其首個付費 AI 模型
article.summary_zh: Meta 於周四推出了 Muse Spark 1.1，這是其 AI 平台的重大更新，距離 AI 主管 Alexandr Wang 推出首個模型僅三個月。此舉表明 Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg 急於縮小與 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的差距。

article.title: OpenAI, Microsoft & Anthropic agree on who runs the agent. They disagree on what you can take back.
article.summary: OpenAI announced ChatGPT Work on July 9 and began rolling it out to Pro, Enterprise, and Edu users. It runs on the new GPT-5.6, opens a user’s local files, edits Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 documents, and carries a multi-step task through to a finished deliverable. Reuters placed it directly against Anthropic’s Claude Cowork , and both target the same person — a non-coder who wants the power of a coding agent without the terminal. Counting Anthropic, Microsoft, Perplexity, and Amazon, five leading labs have now released an agent of this kind. The batch shows that the newest agents are organized more by their intended users than by their functions. article.title_zh: OpenAI、Microsoft 和 Anthropic 在誰執行 agent 上達成共識，但在你能取回什麼上存在分歧
article.summary_zh: OpenAI 在 7 月 9 日宣布推出 ChatGPT Work，運行在新的 GPT-5.6 上，可開啟用戶本地文件、編輯 Google Workspace 和 Microsoft 365 文件，並將多步驟任務完成至最終交付物。

article.title: Why zero vulnerability code packages could still be your biggest software supply chain risk
article.summary: The unwelcome specter of software supply chain security threats has been the main character in the narrative security specialists have laid out this year.  Red Hat targeted application-layer dependencies with Lightwell; both GitLab and GitHub put AI services forward to provide deeper code scanning and software composition analysis (SCA) know-how; Harness continues to clarify its position on automated pipeline security gates to block unverified or untrusted third-party artifacts; and of course, Gartner magically lists every vendor worth its salt in this space. Against this backdrop, dedicated software supply chain security specialist RapidFort announced a new working partnership this week with file security vendor ReversingLabs to deliver Open Source Dependency Libraries, a softwa
article.title_zh: 為什麼零漏洞代碼套件仍可能是你最大的軟體供應鏈風險
article.summary_zh: 軟體供應鏈安全威脅一直是安全專家今年關注的焦點，Red Hat 使用 Lightwell 針對應用層依賴關係，而 GitLab 和 GitHub 都推出 AI 服務以提供更深層的代碼掃描。

article.title: China Chip Firm Nexchip Rises in HK After $891 Million Listing
article.summary: Nexchip Semiconductor Corp. jumped as much as 14% Friday after raising $891 million in a share sale, showing the appetite for Chinese chipmakers after a deluge of offerings in the artificial intelligence industry.
article.title_zh: 中國晶片公司 Nexchip 香港上市後股價上升，融資 8.91 億美元
article.summary_zh: Nexchip 半導體有限公司週五上漲 14%，融資 8.91 億美元，展現了在人工智慧產業大量新股發行後對中國晶片製造商的需求。

article.title: JPMorgan Builds AI Agents That Beat 60/40 Portfolio in Backtests
article.summary: As investors increasingly turn to artificial intelligence for help with everything from stock picking to risk management, JPMorgan Chase & Co. has been testing whether a model can do something more ambitious: allocate money itself.
article.title_zh: 摩根大通開發 AI 代理人在回測中擊敗 60/40 投資組合
article.summary_zh: 摩根大通測試 AI 模型是否能自動配置資金，這比股票選擇和風險管理等傳統應用更具野心。

article.title: How Once-Struggling SK Hynix Became a Trillion-Dollar Company
article.summary: SK Hynix Inc. is hardly a household name. But the maker of memory chips, which two decades ago was struggling to survive, is now South Korea’s second-most valuable listed company, just behind Samsung Electronics Co.
article.title_zh: 曾經陷入困境的 SK Hynix 如何成為市值一兆美元的公司
article.summary_zh: SK Hynix Inc. 幾乎不是家喻戶曉的名字，但這家二十年前苦苦掙扎求生的記憶體晶片製造商，如今已成為韓國第二最有價值的上市公司，僅次於三星電子。

article.title: I used to love Claude, but the latest models are slowly ruining it
article.summary: Credit: Megan Ellis / Android Authority For those who have followed my past work, I’ve recently considered leaving Claude for Gemini , as the latter chatbot is a much better value. Still, I’ve remained on the fence largely because I find that Claude is the best AI partner for following long, detailed threads. Its memory is exceptional compared to Gemini, and it can search backward through your chat more readily than ChatGPT . I really feel like I’m talking to a collaborative partner in a way I don’t with other tools. Or at least, I used to. Over the last few weeks, I’ve found that Claude is increasingly difficult to work with. article.title_zh: 我曾熱愛 Claude，但最新的模型正在慢慢毀掉它
article.summary_zh: Claude 作為 AI 助手曾備受推崇，但最新版本開始面臨性能下降的問題，促使用戶考慮轉向 Gemini。
